description: We have unlimited capacity no need to bring difficulties #selflove #maturity #selfleadership
transcript: I live a very big, expansive life, and I have unlimited capacity for that life. I've created a foundation that is solid and steadfast. When things become complex, when things become overcomplicated, I know that that thing is not meant for my life. I know it's not for me because I'm able to handle all the things in my life, even when they are difficult. To fill out things to come and go, everything is temporary.
